metadata.description: Country-year total population, UN World Population Prospects 2024 via Our World in Data. One example per entity-year, 1950-2025; estimates 1950-2023 are the primary analysis window and 2024-2025 are flagged projections.
metadata.do_not_pool_panels: WDI is sourced from national statistical offices for roughly one third of economies, so the companion panel tests source invariance, not the same numbers twice. Never concatenate the two datasets.
